sources.caveat: Read 7 Nov 2026. Lists 997 ambulance, 999 police, 998 fire, 911 as general emergency.

sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience: executive summary (2016)

content.en: Ambulance, fire and police: 911 (unified). No Saudi SIM: call 112.
content.ar: الإسعاف والإطفاء والشرطة: 911 (موحد). بدون شريحة سعودية: اتصلي بـ 112.

items.notes: FCDO says 911 for ambulance/fire/police plus 112 for no-SIM. Smartraveller lists 997 ambulance, 999 police, 998 fire AND 911 general. App currently shows 997 with 911 as note (open founder decision). Both numbers well-evidenced. Recommend showing 911 as the primary unified number and 997 as the ambulance-specific note, pending founder decision.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Founder to decide: 911 primary or 997 primary. A Saudi reviewer to confirm.

content.en: Tdap vaccine is recommended in pregnancy in Saudi Arabia. The preferred window is 27 to 36 weeks (based on international guidance widely cited in the region; Saudi MOH specific timing not read).
content.ar: لقاح الكزاز والدفتيريا والسعال الديكي (Tdap) موصى به في الحمل في المملكة العربية السعودية. النافذة المفضلة 27 إلى 36 أسبوعًا.

items.notes: Saudi MOH 2019 page does not give Tdap weeks. 27-36 weeks is from international consensus (CDC, ACOG) and is used in Bahrain and Qatar. A Saudi MOH vaccine page or SRCA guidance is needed.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Saudi immunologist or MOH vaccine schedule page to confirm weeks and whether Tdap is routine or recommended.

content.en: The Saudi Ministry of Health advises folic acid from when planning a pregnancy until week 12. No specific dose was found on the page read.
content.ar: توصي وزارة الصحة السعودية بحمض الفوليك من مرحلة التخطيط للحمل حتى الأسبوع 12. لم نجد جرعة محددة في الصفحة المقروءة.

items.notes: 2019 page; dose not stated. WHO recommends 400 mcg daily (WHO-ANC).
items.reviewerMustSupply: Saudi MOH or SFDA current leaflet for the dose.

content.en: The Saudi Ministry of Health recommends iron-rich foods to prevent anemia. No iron supplement dose was found on the MOH page read.
content.ar: توصي وزارة الصحة السعودية بتناول أطعمة غنية بالحديد. لم يُذكر مكمل الحديد بجرعة محددة في الصفحة المقروءة.

items.notes: WHO recommends 30-60 mg daily (WHO-ANC). MOH page does not give a supplement dose.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Saudi MOH or pharmacist to confirm supplement recommendation.

content.en: No Saudi Ministry of Health antenatal appointment schedule was found in this pass. WHO recommends a minimum of eight contacts during pregnancy.
content.ar: لم نجد جدول مواعيد الرعاية السابقة للولادة من وزارة الصحة السعودية. منظمة الصحة العالمية توصي بما لا يقل عن 8 زيارات.

items.notes: No MOH schedule found; research articles confirm antenatal care is widespread but do not give an official appointment schedule.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Saudi obstetrician or MOH maternal health page.

content.en: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA, sfda.gov.sa) is the medicines regulator. Its pages were not read in this pass.
content.ar: الهيئة السعودية للغذاء والدواء (SFDA) هي الجهة التنظيمية للأدوية. لم تُقرأ صفحاتها في هذه المرحلة.

items.reviewerMustSupply: Pharmacist to supply the SFDA pregnancy/breastfeeding information pages to use.

content.en: No official mental health or women's helpline for Saudi Arabia was found with two independent sources in this pass.
content.ar: لم نجد خطًا ساخنًا رسميًا للصحة النفسية أو دعم المرأة بمصدرين مستقلين.

items.notes: therapyroute.com lists a crisis line but is not an official source.
items.reviewerMustSupply: A Saudi reviewer to name the official service.
